text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: Although the paper includes global land use change scenarios and maps land use changes at 1 km² resolution globally with national-level implications, its primary focus is on estimating the future value of ecosystem services under alternative global scenarios rather than on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction per se. The scenarios and land use projections are derived from existing GTI scenarios rather than developed or validated by the authors, and no spatial modeling accuracy metrics or quantitative validation of LULC predictions are reported. The paper does not present spatially explicit LULC prediction as the central research question, but rather uses existing scenario-based land use changes as inputs to estimate ecosystem service values. Furthermore, the analysis is at a global scale with national disaggregation mainly to report ecosystem service values, not to evaluate or validate spatial LULC predictions. Therefore, it does not meet the core inclusion criteria for national-scale spatial LULC prediction modeling with accuracy assessment, nor is it a review synthesizing LULC prediction research. Hence it is excluded.)
